about_the_game:
"Trickshotterz is if Beer Pong grew legs and turned into a chaotic physics brawler"

Play with up to 4 players, local couch play or online PvP

A GAME ABOUT STYLE

The flashier and riskier your shot is:

  • Bounce shots

  • Mid-air plays

  • Clutch angles

  • +PROJECTILE BOOST

  • Ball jump

  • Rocket ride

  • ...and way more variations

... the harder it hits.

You can still score with any shot, but when you land something wild, the game makes it hit different.

You can chain these together to create insane combos too: Imagine rocket riding into an explosion, getting pushed back, ball jumping into a sniper +PROJECTILE BOOST. Every round becomes a highlight reel.

POWERUPS

Pickup wild powerup balls that spawn mid-match and flip the game in your favor:

  • Fire an RPG that bursts into a frenzy of mini balls

  • Steer a Remote-Control Ball to hit impossible angles

  • Launch a Shockwave Ball to send opponents and the level into the stratosphere

  • Unleash a mini black hole that devours everything around it

  • ...and many more to discover

Every powerup is physics-driven, and designed for chaotic, clip-worthy “YOOOOOOO!” moments.

ABILITIES DESIGNED FOR TRICKSHOTS AND FUN

Before each set of rounds, choose one ability to define your playstyle.

Every choice reshapes how you fight and score.

  • Wind Blast: parry anything, including your own ball (+PROJECTILE BOOST)

  • Dash: barely escape a shot or reposition yourself for the perfect setup

  • Ball Suck: after shooting your ball, use the ability to bring it back to you so you can hit crazy angle plays

  • ...and many more abilities that completely change the way you play

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit only
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: SCORE IN THE TOP OF THE CUP. Pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.
